seeding.SEEDING_MAP_SLOT_INVALID: This stage's seeding map has an invalid position. Fix the seeding rules and try again.
seeding.SEEDING_MAP_SOURCE_INVALID: This stage's seeding map points to a qualifier that doesn't exist. Fix the seeding rules and try again.
seeding.SEEDING_RULES_MISSING: This stage has no seeding rules, or its generated fixtures no longer match them. Add seeding rules, or regenerate this stage's fixtures.
seeding.SEEDING_SOURCE_INCOMPLETE: The source stage isn't finished yet. Complete it before computing this proposal.
seeding.SEEDING_BESTNTH_UNEQUAL_POOLS: These groups have played different numbers of games, so their standings can't be compared yet.
seeding.SEEDING_ALREADY_CONFIRMED: This stage's slots are already filled from a confirmed proposal.
seeding.SEEDING_PROPOSAL_STALE: Standings changed since this proposal was computed. Recompute it to see the current qualifiers.
seeding.SEEDING_EDIT_UNKNOWN_SLOT: One of your edits refers to a slot this proposal doesn't have. Recompute the proposal and try again.
seeding.SEEDING_TIE_UNRESOLVED: Resolve every tied slot before confirming — pick which entrant fills each one.
seeding.SEEDING_SLOT_DOUBLE_ASSIGNED: The same entrant is assigned to more than one slot. Fix your edits and try again.
seeding.SEEDING_ENTRANT_FOREIGN: One of the qualifying entrants no longer belongs to this division.
seeding.SEEDING_SLOT_FOREIGN_FIXTURE: One of the destination slots belongs to a different stage. Recompute the proposal and try again.
seeding.SEEDING_FIXTURES_ALREADY_FILLED: One of the destination slots is already filled. Recompute the proposal to see what's left.
